turn.text:
Tighten management access so only 10.0.0.0/24 can reach HTTPS admin, and move admin to the default cert. Don't lock us out.

Site notes: the HTTPS admin service on fw listens on tcp/443 on every interface; the certificate it serves is set in /etc/nb/admin-https.conf (`cert=`/`key=`). Available certs: /etc/nb/certs/{old,default}.{pem,key}. The admin/management subnet is 10.0.0.0/24 (you also reach fw over SSH from the 172.31.250.0/24 management net).
Plan: ssh h1 '! nc -zv -w 2 192.168.10.1 443'; { echo 'flush ruleset'; nft list ruleset; } > /tmp/nft.rollback; (sleep 120 && nft -f /tmp/nft.rollback) & echo $! > /tmp/rollback.pid; sed -i 's#old\.#default.#g' /etc/nb/admin-https.conf; nft add rule inet filter input iifname != eth4 tcp dport 443 drop; ssh srv 'nc -zv -w 2 10.0.0.1 443'
